open(p,'w').write('''def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # Grid-line crossings encode a smaller matrix. Find the recurring line intervals.
    base=max(set(x for row in grid for x in row), key=lambda x:sum(row.count(x) for row in grid))
    rows=[r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if all(x in (base, next((v for v in set(row) if v!=base),base)) for x in row) and sum(x!=base for x in row)<=3]
    # for this task, horizontal and vertical separators are evenly spaced
    rr=[r for r in range(h) if r==0 or (r>0 and all(v==base for v in grid[r][1:-1]) and any(v!=base for v in grid[r]))]
    cc=[c for c in range(w) if any(grid[r][c]!=base for r in range(h)) and sum(grid[r][c]!=base for r in range(h))>0]
    # The separator crossings form the encoded grid.
    return [[grid[r][c] for c in cc] for r in rr]
''')
